status: remaining two planned exploratory experiments on previously viewed historical data

two_parameter_calibration.constraint: b=1+g/std >=0; positive forecast and monotonic response to original forecast
two_parameter_calibration.objective: sum(QLIKE) + alpha/2*(d^2+g^2), alpha=10; identity at d=g=0
two_parameter_calibration.updates: every forecast origin; original issued log forecasts; same mature-history qualification as scalar experiment
two_parameter_calibration.sensitivity: fixed half log correction, exp(log(f)+0.5*(d+g*z)); no second parameter fit
two_parameter_calibration.label_eligibility: historical origin < current origin and target_end strictly < current asof_time
two_parameter_calibration.phase_boundary: continuous history; recovered boundary targets enter only after maturity; not added to development scoring

qlike_training.forecast: exp(intercept + standardized original log-HAR / log-HAR+IV features)
qlike_training.objective: sum(QLIKE) + alpha/2*sum(slope^2); intercept unpenalized; alpha=10 fixed
qlike_training.information_structure: same original features and union-complete sample across V0/V1/V2/V3; no new features
qlike_training.standardization: within each strictly matured training sample only
qlike_training.literature_relation: loss-coherent positive-link extension using original log features; not a literal replication of level-linear qlikeHAR
qlike_training.regularization_note: same fixed numerical ridge alpha but losses have different curvature; not an exactly matched effective-complexity comparison

optimizer.method: analytic gradient/Hessian damped projected Newton; convex log-link QLIKE objective
optimizer.failure_policy: stop and document numerical problem, never silently omit forecasts or switch methods by outcome

sample: all 2 models x 7 methods share scoring rows; compare coverage to prior scalar experiment
secondary_metrics: new forecast log-MSE (not substituted for old log-MSE)
loss_family: 66 prespecified paired comparisons per phase/block: inherited scalar 28, new methods vs direct/smearing 24, two-parameter vs corresponding scalar 8, new-method IV increment 6

paired_inference.multiplicity: Holm across the full 66 comparison family per phase/block, including older methods
paired_inference.interpretation: descriptive centered circular-block bootstrap conditional on issued forecasts

mz_inference: HAC lag21/42; Holm across 28 joint alpha=0,beta=1 tests per phase/lag; marginal intervals unadjusted
no_selection: no tuning of alpha, windows, shrinkage, regimes or method using results; all variants reported
independent_validation: finite-difference derivatives, known-model recovery, future-label perturbations, SciPy optimizer cross-checks on fixed synthetic and production samples
limitations: already viewed historical data; new untouched data needed for independent confirmation
OHLC/overnight variance proxy, not latent conditional variance
base-data vendor timestamps and settlement-family issues remain unresolved
